spell.name: Fireball

components.m: a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur

entries: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger. Each creature takes {@damage 8d6} fire damage on a failed save.

spell.name: Bless
entries: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range.

item.name: Cloak of Protection
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

feat.name: Alert
entries: Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +5 bonus to initiative.
